name: @muraldevkit/ui-toolkit-mcp

tools.name: list-components
tools.description: List all documented components. Returns an array of { name, summary }, where summary is design intent (null when undocumented). This is the entry point for discovering exact, case-sensitive component names to pass to get-component; call it first when you don't already know the name. Takes no arguments and does not include props, examples, or page content.

tools.name: get-component
tools.description: Get the complete record for a single component, looked up by its exact case-sensitive name. Returns { name, import, designIntent, docs, props, inherits, examples, storybookUrl, pageId, zeroheightUrl }. designIntent is a one-line summary. storybookUrl is the live Storybook link for the component's canonical story (null when it has no story); cite it alongside zeroheightUrl. docs mirrors the styleguide page tabs — docs.overview { intro, hasStorybookExample, extraInformation }, docs.usage { intro, bestPractices, contentGuidelines, extraInformation }, docs.accessibility { intro, keyboardNavigation, labels, ariaRolesAndProperties, extraInformation } — each field markdown prose denoised from the page (images and Figma/Storybook embeds removed), or null when the page lacks that section. props is an array of { name, type, default, required, description, deprecated }, and examples is an array of { title, code }. props lists only the toolkit's own props; the component also accepts every prop of the types in inherits (e.g. "React.ComponentProps<'input'>"). When a prop's type field names a TypeScript type (e.g. "MrlSmartTableColumn[]"), you can resolve its shape with *get-type* tool. Call list-components first if you are unsure of the exact name; an unknown name returns an error listing how to look it up.

tools.name: get-type
tools.description: Get the source definition of a named TypeScript type referenced by a component prop's type field (e.g. "MrlSmartTableColumn", "MrlAvatarPropTypes"). Returns { name, kind, definition, resolved?, source }, where kind is "interface" or "type", definition is the verbatim TypeScript source, resolved (type aliases only) is the compiler-expanded type such as a string-literal union, and source is the file path it was captured from. Use this to expand prop types surfaced by get-component; the name must match exactly. For component records themselves use get-component, not this tool; an unknown name returns an error.

tools.name: get-tokens
tools.description: Get Mural design tokens in DTCG (Design Tokens Community Group) format: a tree keyed by group, where leaf nodes are { $value, $type?, $description? } and $value is a string, number, or array of them. Pass no argument to return every group; pass group to return only that group's subtree — an unknown group returns an error listing the valid ones. The 57 groups are: radii, stroke, gray, blue, red, tomato, orange, lemon, melon, mint, blueberry, grape, dragonfruit, truffle, white, black, status, white-opacity, black-opacity, timing, duration, distance, shadow, spacing, baseline, font-family, font-size, line-height, letter-spacing, font-weight, line-width, border-radius, border, border-hover, border-active, border-selected, border-disabled, border-emph, border-emph-hover, border-emph-active, border-emph-selected, border-inverse, border-inverse-hover, border-inverse-active, border-inverse-selected, border-inverse-disabled, border-focus, border-divider, color, shadows, space, body-font, heading, type-size, type-line-height, type-weight, type-spacing.

group.description: Optional exact token group name to filter by, e.g. "radii". Omit to return all groups.

tools.name: list-pages
tools.description: List all styleguide pages. Returns an array of { id, title, path, components }, where id is a number, path is the sidebar breadcrumb array (e.g. ["Components", "ACTIONS"], empty when the page is absent from the nav tree), and components lists the component names documented on that page. Use it to discover page ids and titles before calling *get-page* tool. Takes no arguments and does not return page body content.

tools.name: get-page
tools.description: Get one full styleguide page, looked up by numeric id (e.g. "4672209") or exact title (e.g. "Buttons"). Returns { id, title, url, path, introduction, content, tabs, components }, where tabs is an array of { name, url, content } holding the body of tabbed pages (tab names such as "Overview", "Usage", "Accessibility"; url deep-links to that tab in zeroheight when available). Titles are matched exactly and are not unique — an ambiguous title returns an error listing the candidate ids to retry with. Call list-pages first to discover valid ids and titles.

page.description: The numeric page id (e.g. "4672209") or the exact page title (e.g. "Buttons").
